amounts-at-length.text: {"recap": "Ann De Wilde (De Wilde Partners) says invoice 1249.50 EUR from August is still open and past due, and asks you to check whether payment was sent. Tom Claes quoted 3480 EUR excl. VAT for the cabinet wall, valid 30 days. Jan Vanhoof issued a 612.40 EUR credit note for a double-charged delivery, to be offset against your next invoice. Timmermans says your 2150 EUR advance invoice was forwarded to their accounts and will be paid this week. Bart Wouters asks the price for 40 running meters of standard profile for a client quote. Peter Segers is ordering 18 samples from the autumn range, no rush. Also: the energy supplier refunds 87.35 EUR within ten working days, and Lies Vergote confirms your 890 EUR payment cleared, so no reminder is needed.", "nothing_important": false}

long-day-train-2.text: {"recap": "Peeters Transport reports that a software update since last week is creating duplicate invoices. They have already cancelled 9 and want it looked at urgently. Vergote CV says the latest invoice is missing their VAT number and needs a corrected version. Dendooven advocaten found two clauses in your terms and conditions to adjust before publishing, and asks for a call this week. D'Haene Koeltechniek cancelled Friday's intervention and offers Monday morning instead. Vandewalle Schrijnwerk confirmed the installation date: their team arrives in the morning for a full working day. Maes Tuinaanleg wants to schedule works for October and asks which weeks are free, except the second week. Claeys Elektro asks which day suits the periodic installation inspection this quarter. Desmedt Koeling says a part they ordered won't be available next month and asks for a recommended alternative. De Clercq Transport asks whether fixed loading time slots are possible, since their drivers often wait a long time. The rest is newsletters, automated notices and marketing.", "nothing_important": false}

long-day-train-3.text: {"recap": "Several items need a reply. Dirk Lambrecht asks if the material delivery is on schedule, since his crew is ready from the third week. Marc Desmet complains about 12 damaged boxes from last week's delivery and wants a proposed solution this week. Anne Verstraete asks you to check and confirm the company details in the draft deed. Jelle Moeyaert's warehouse moves next month and he needs the delivery address updated. Els D'Hondt asks for a revised quote with the changed dimensions. Rik Vandamme is waiting for last month's works invoice and wants it this week. Sofie Vandenberghe changes the order form, profiles from 24 to 30, and asks for confirmation. Chris Baert needs the technical sheet for a delivered unit, Nele De Jaeger needs a conformity certificate (no rush), Hans Vanacker asks to move next week's site visit one week later, and Inge De Bruyne wants sample cards of the autumn range for a client next week. The rest is newsletters, promotions and automated notices.", "nothing_important": false}
